entries.title: Psalms 130:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> Out of the deep have I sent up my cry to you, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 130:2
segments: Lord, let my voice come before you: let your ears be awake to the voice of my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 130:3
segments: O Jah, if you took note of every sin, who would go free?

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
segments: But there is forgiveness with you, so that you may be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 130:5
segments: ¶I am waiting for the Lord, my soul is waiting for him, and my hope is in his word.

entries.title: Psalms 130:6
segments: My soul is watching for the Lord more than those who are watching for the morning; yes, more than the watchers for the morning.

entries.title: Psalms 130:7
segments: O Israel, have hope in the Lord; for with the Lord is mercy and full salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 130:8
segments: And he will make Israel free from all his sins.
